termZh: 强迫 - 颜色 - 规范
definitionZh: 强制色彩- adjust CSS 属性允许作者从强制色彩模式中选择某些元素. 然后将这些值的控制恢复到CSS.
sourceDefinition: The forced-color-adjust CSS property allows authors to opt certain elements out of forced colors mode. This then restores the control of those values to CSS.
